title: Container Bookings: which customer rolls still owe a roll fee
content:
## Rule
Under the Container Bookings product line, the customer rolls of a booking are its roll entries whose recorded initiator is the customer. When their number does not exceed the tier's free customer rolls, no roll owes a fee; otherwise the rolls owing a fee are that number less the tier's free customer rolls. The rolls still owing a fee are the rolls owing a fee less the customer roll fee entries already on the booking; when no roll is still owing a fee, nothing is charged. The rolls still owing a fee are the latest customer rolls of the booking. Carrier rolls never owe this fee.

## Truth table (hypothetical tier with 1 free customer roll)
| Customer rolls recorded | Rolls owing a fee | Customer roll fee entries on the booking | Rolls still owing | Which rolls |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 | none; nothing is charged |
| 2 | 1 | 0 | 1 | the latest customer roll |
| 3 | 2 | 1 | 1 | the latest customer roll |
| 3 | 2 | 2 | 0 | none; nothing is charged |

*Counts are hypothetical inputs, for illustration only.*

## Points of judgement
**The booking was also rolled twice by the line.** Carrier rolls are not counted; only rolls recorded with the customer as initiator enter the count.

**Where do the figures come from?** From the booking's own roll entries and customer roll fee entries.
